newsitem.title: UK: Electrocomponents says key markets growing.
newsitem.headline: Electrocomponents says key markets growing.

text.p: British electronic and electrical components marketing group Electrocomponents Plc on Monday announced a 13 percent rise in annual pre-tax profits and said the current year had got off to a good start.
"The year has started well with growth in all of our important markets and an indication of improving market conditions in mainland Europe," Electrocomponents said in a statement.

"Our sales are increasing in the UK, however, the continued strength of sterling has had an impact on the export-oriented manufacturing industry which is an important area of our business," the company said.
Pre-tax profit in the year to March 1997 rose 13.3 percent to 112.4 million stg on an 8.2 percent increase in sales to 605.8 million.
